query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash, script_hash AS h FROM transaction_scripts WHERE date in <year window> UNION ALL SELECT date, tx_hash, owner_payment_credential AS h FROM address_utxo WHERE date >= DATE '2021-09-01' AND date < DATE '2022-01-01') WHERE h IN ('1f3aec8bfe7ea4fe14c5f121e2a92e301afe414147860d557cac7e34', 'a3d5052864638828bc3fbc0d5b9a4223e233620d7911a5376ed4b658', 'd2c3f66c2c7154d9f0b913ee3cd9b0a25bbb7d1537953d7c36c07e86', 'd74de93a7e4940462c4509f59c712889422506f8b63dcfd0c266dc7b') UNION ALL SELECT date, tx_hash FROM address_utxo WHERE date >= DATE '2021-09-01' AND date < DATE '2022-01-01' AND policy_id IN ('1f3aec8bfe7ea4fe14c5f121e2a92e301afe414147860d557cac7e34')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
